subject: Is building your AI models painful?
text:
Hi [NAME] 

Saw you are working as Senior Scientist at Brain Corporation.​

If you spend a significant amount of time using different apps for annotating/labeling, curating/indexing data, and model eval, it may be time to consider an end to end platform like Encord. We have had hundreds of AI teams join us in [YEAR] to either optimize or consolidate their ML team workflows. Saving you time, money, and providing you speed to market. 

Don't become numb to the pain of building your ML workflows because they get you by. Make your life and your teams better God willing by using Encord.

Does this resonate with you?

subject: Build vs buy
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Noticed that you were part of the [COMPANY] team acquired by Genius Sports a few years ago & thought it would make sense to introduce Encord, given your team's experience in Computer Vision.

subject: Adverse weather data
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Skydio and Zipline, so thought it might make sense to explore if we could help at [COMPANY] in a similar way.

Many of the Autonomous Drone teams we work with found curating training datasets from large volumes of customer / development data to be cumbersome, often relying on immature OS tools or one-off custom scripts as workarounds.

At Encord, we've built an Enterprise-grade solution for ML teams to index and explore their datasets within our UI (using embeddings visualisations & quality metric filters) to quickly mine edge cases (e.g. find data in poor weather conditions) & accelerate model development.

Open to learning more?

subject: Build your AI Models Faster & Cheaper
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

While I was doing some research on [COMPANY]​ I noticed you may be building your own models. Encord helps support and consolidate the apps required to train and evaluate your AI models in a single place. We currently work with images, videos, audio, and text annotation/segmentation. We have had hundreds of new clients in [YEAR] and would love to see if we would be of value to your team.

We are focused on data curation/indexing, annotation/segmentation and model evaluation. Would it make sense to jump on a quick 30 minute call to give us feedback?

subject: [Invite] Encord AI Leaders Dinner @ Kokkari 02/27
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our Co-Founders, [SENDER] & [SENDER], will be hosting an intimate AI roundtable
dinner for customers & AI leaders and we'd love for you to join if you're
interested / can make it!

We've booked a private dining room at Kokkari in SF on Thursday February
27th 6:30-9:30pm, capping attendance to ~25 people. Attendees include CxOs

workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

Thought it was a good opportunity to get connected - would you be
interested in joining? I can send over an invite if so.

subject: SageMaker Ground Truth Development
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently heard from several large SageMaker customers who, upon learning that Ground Truth is no longer in active development, are looking for ways to future proof against any depreciation risk.

Let me know if you're interested in discussing how we're mitigating this for similar partners,

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a multimodal data development platform, supporting Audio, Video & Text. We enable Audio AI teams to accelerate the fine-tuning of their ASR / TTS models at scale, by bringing data management, visualisation & HITL workflows into a single platform.

text:
[NAME],

I came across your work over at Odysight - inspired to read on your
LinkedIn of your early experiences gathering the neighbourhood "kids gang"!

I was wanting to connect about improvements to your AI Data Development
setup.

Specifically, we've had quite a few users of other platforms like V7,
Dataloop, and Voxel51 move over to Encord due to lack of sophisticated
capabilities with video annotation, video curation, inadequate workflows &
model in the loop capabilities etc.

improve your current systems and better address any of the challenges
you're facing with your Computer Vision model development.

Might you be open to an introductory call with me and the team to explore
how Encord can best serve Odysight?

Very best,
